To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the criteria for evaluating a design research are dependent on the research approach (positivist, critical or interpretive) and the evaluation criteria for the design outcomes are dependent on the stakeholder group (user, designer, manager, customer, etc.).

the evaluation of design models and instantiations should be based on a) the perspective of the researcher, b) the stake holders of the system under study and c) the evaluation criteria of the stake holders.
1) The goodness of a model depends on the perspective of the research, the research question and the research approach.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how to model and evaluate design outcomes in the context of different perspectives on the world.
the following questions: How to evaluate models and outcomes in the design research?
the question of what are the criteria of goodness of models and outcomes in the design research.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
there are no general guidelines for the evaluation of design outcomes, but there are some general guidelines on the evaluation of models.
the evaluation criteria depend on the research approach, the research problem and the research outcome.
there are many different ways to evaluate the models and the outcomes in design research.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the goodness of the model depends on the goodness of the instantiation.
we have to consider the different perspectives and criteria in the design process and to evaluate both models and instantiations in a wider sense than the prevalent positivist approach.
we have to take different approaches for different purposes, and the choice of approach depends on the purpose of the research.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the goodness of a model or instantiation is dependent on the perspective of the researcher and the criteria of the stake holders.
there are different criteria of goodness for different research approaches and that these criteria should be applied in the evaluation of models and instantiations in design research.
we can use different criteria for evaluating the goodness of models and instantiations depending on which research perspective we take.
